reference_anchors.observations: Eight pointed compass star, one clear center stone; accepted silhouette has four longer cardinal arms and four shorter diagonals. Preserve silhouette over equal-length source text.
Exactly seven hanging icicles, shortest at ends and longest at center; shallow diagonal spiral grooves on upper portions. No gemstones or enamel.
One long comet station, two side-by-side clear stones at round head, one pale ice-blue tail inset, Cuban chain. Plain reverse with two stone apertures.
Exactly eight gold rays in flat disc plane; outer navy, white, ice blue and center navy enamel rings separated by gold. No gemstones. Box chain.
Three upright fingers with middle tallest, two outward thumbs; one pale blue center stone inside raised gold eye outline. Franco chain connects at thumb tips.
Two open D-shaped cheeks facing inward; slate-jade enamel on curved edges, two linked central loops, Cuban chain. No gemstones.
Exactly three open stirrups with larger center station, faceted arches, one clear stone in square pad on each base bar. Franco chain between base ends.
One side-profile cardinal, berry breast inset, one clear eye stone, raised tail and polished wing. Preserve visible open gap below tail and source outline.
One six-sided plate, continuous pale ice-blue hexagon band and small raised center hexagon with one clear stone. Source proportions override any impression of a full enamel center.
One scarab with two slate-jade wing fields, central gold divider, five shield fan slits and source raised dot row (appears seven dots vs six in source text), six short legs. No stones; Cuban chain.
